cap: About 5 to 10 percent of breast cancers are hereditary, and each gene explains its cancers by its normal job. BRCA1 and BRCA2 repair double-strand DNA breaks; BRCA1 carriers tend to have triple-negative breast cancer and BRCA2 carriers estrogen receptor-positive cancer and male breast cancer. TP53 loss causes Li-Fraumeni syndrome, PTEN Cowden syndrome, STK11 Peutz-Jeghers syndrome, and CDH1 loss of E-cadherin, which gives lobular cancer.
